subject: bin2d and hex mapped to other scale (alpha)

messages.author: 12bf1643119920d6
messages.subject: bin2d and hex mapped to other scale (alpha)
parts:
Is it possible to map the value of the bins from bind2d and hex to another scale than fill, notably alpha?  So that the bins with the largest counts are more opaque.

Thank you

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: bin2d and hex mapped to other scale (alpha)
parts:
Yes, you can do this as follows:

d <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, price))
d + geom_bin2d(aes(alpha=..count..))

Note that stat_bin2d does not document ..count.. as a return value (as
stat_bin does), so I discovered this by making the educated guess that
stat_bin2d works the same way as ?stat_bin. This really should be
documented.

Best,
Ista

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: bin2d and hex mapped to other scale (alpha)
parts:
Hi:

Generally speaking, the I() construct is specific to qplot(), but it
doesn't seem to cause any problems here when used with ggplot(). It's
not clear to me which of the two legends you want to remove (I would
guess the colorbar), but try these:

# library(scales)
# Gets rid of the grey scale legend:
d + geom_bin2d(aes(alpha = ..count..), fill = "black") +
scale_alpha(guide = "none")

# Gets rid of the fill colorbar:
d + geom_bin2d(aes(alpha = ..count..), fill = "black") +
scale_fill_continuous(guide = "none")

Dennis
